title: GTA6 Official Website Adds 30 New PS5 Screenshots
description: Following last week's Extended Look, Rockstar Games has added 30 new GTA6 screenshots to its official website, showcasing stunning PS5 visuals.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rockstar Expands GTA6 Website with 30 New PS5 Screenshots

Following the breathtaking Extended Look that took the gaming world by storm last week, Rockstar Games is keeping the momentum going by adding 30 new screenshots of *GTA6* to its official website, according to a recent report by gaming outlet Push Square.

These newly released images offer fans an even closer look at the stunning visual fidelity of the upcoming open-world epic. While some of these exact images were previously shared exclusively among select influencers—meaning eagle-eyed fans might have already spotted things like the now-famous iguana floating around on social media platforms—they are now officially available for everyone to examine in high definition.

### A Showcase of Next-Gen Visuals

The addition of these 30 screenshots highlights the incredible attention to detail Rockstar is pouring into the PS5 version of the game. From the vibrant and sun-drenched ecosystems of Leonida to intricate character models and environmental lighting, the visual leap is hard to overstate.

Industry analysts note that releasing these official assets sequentially is a calculated move to maintain the staggering level of hype generated by the recent extended footage. It allows the community to dissect every single frame, keeping the conversation alive and driving engagement across all gaming forums and social channels.

### Community Excitement Reaches New Heights

Since the major media drop last week, the *GTA6* community has been in a state of constant discovery, and this website update provides fuel for countless hours of speculation and analysis. Fans have been combing through the new additions to spot hidden details, vehicle designs, and the sheer density of the game's simulated world.

As Rockstar continues to drip-feed high-quality material, anticipation for the title remains at an all-time high. We will continue to monitor all official updates and bring you the latest news as it happens.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar's strategy of following up a major media showcase with a fresh batch of official website screenshots is pure masterclass in hype management. Seeing these images—especially the impressive wildlife details like the iguana—serves as a strong reminder of the technical milestone *GTA6* aims to achieve on current-gen hardware. It's a visual treat that leaves us wanting more.
